paragraphs: There's very little difference between Snowie'’s EP3 Opening range and its EP2 opening range. Thus, there’s very little difference in its SB defense range against the two. Snowie can open almost the exact same range because players in middle position are sandwiched between the opener and the “squeezers” behind them.
